levels.name: Reading
levels.blurb: The alphabet, the vowels, and sounding out your first real words. No prior Hebrew assumed.

lessons.title: The first six letters
lessons.goal: Recognise א ב ג ד ה ו and know what each one sounds like.

lessons.title: Six more
lessons.goal: Add ז ח ט י כ ל, and start telling apart the pairs that look alike.

lessons.title: Six more still
lessons.goal: Add מ נ ס ע פ צ — including the second silent letter.

lessons.title: The last four
lessons.goal: Finish the alphabet with ק ר ש ת.

lessons.title: Letters that change at the end
lessons.goal: Read ך ם ן ף ץ — the same five letters in their end-of-word shapes.

lessons.title: Vowels: a and e
lessons.goal: Read the four marks that make the a and e sounds.

lessons.title: Vowels: i, o, u — and the one that says nothing
lessons.goal: Finish the vowel system, including the shva.

lessons.title: The dot that changes the sound
lessons.goal: Read בּ/ב, כּ/כ, פּ/פ — and sound out whole words unaided.

lessons.title: Where the weight falls
lessons.goal: Put the stress in the right place — the last thing between you and a readable word.

levels.name: Ulpan Alef
levels.blurb: Nouns, adjectives, the present tense — enough Hebrew to say what is where and who is doing what.

lessons.title: Hello, and who you are
lessons.goal: Greet someone and name yourself and them.

lessons.title: Every noun has a gender
lessons.goal: Tell masculine nouns from feminine ones, and know the exceptions that matter.

lessons.title: One and many
lessons.goal: Form plurals, and recognise the irregular ones you'll use daily.

lessons.title: Family and people
lessons.goal: Name everyone at the table — and notice which words come in gendered pairs.

lessons.title: The
lessons.goal: Use הַ, and know why it sometimes becomes הָ.

lessons.title: Adjectives agree
lessons.goal: Put an adjective after its noun and match it in gender, number and definiteness.

lessons.title: Colours
lessons.goal: Describe things by colour — and agree the adjective while you're at it.

lessons.title: The house
lessons.goal: Name the rooms and what's in them.

lessons.title: This one and that one
lessons.goal: Point at something — and know why this book has the article twice.

lessons.title: There is, there isn't
lessons.goal: Say what exists and what doesn't.

lessons.title: Describing things
lessons.goal: Forty adjectives, mostly in opposite pairs.

lessons.title: Bigger, smaller, best
lessons.goal: Compare two things, and pick the top of a set.

lessons.title: In, to, from
lessons.goal: Attach בְּ, לְ and מִ, and combine them with the article.

lessons.title: Food and drink
lessons.goal: Order a meal and shop for one.

lessons.title: Asking
lessons.goal: Ask what, who, where, when, why and how much.

lessons.title: What people actually say
lessons.goal: The fixed phrases — greetings, wishes, and the small change of a conversation.

lessons.title: What's happening now
lessons.goal: Use the present tense — four forms, no persons.

lessons.title: Counting
lessons.goal: Count to ten — and pick the right set of numbers.

lessons.title: Numbers past ten
lessons.goal: Count to a thousand, and put things in order.

levels.name: Ulpan Bet
levels.blurb: Owning things, saying what happened, and the endings Hebrew hangs on its prepositions.

lessons.title: Whose it is
lessons.goal: Say that something belongs to someone.

lessons.title: Having
lessons.goal: Say what you have — Hebrew has no verb for it.

lessons.title: Prepositions that decline
lessons.goal: Attach pronoun endings to לְ, בְּ and עִם.

lessons.title: The body, and being unwell
lessons.goal: Point at what hurts.

lessons.title: The word with no meaning
lessons.goal: Use אֶת before a definite direct object.

lessons.title: What happened
lessons.goal: Use the past tense of pa'al, where every person has its own ending.

lessons.title: Days and hours
lessons.goal: Name the days, ask the time, and place things in the week.

lessons.title: The calendar
lessons.goal: Months, festivals and the words that place an event in time.

lessons.title: The city, and getting about
lessons.goal: Find your way and say how you got there.

lessons.title: Half past four
lessons.goal: Tell the time — the one thing the feminine numbers are needed for daily.

lessons.title: The Jewish year
lessons.goal: The festivals, and the objects and words that belong to each.

lessons.title: Exactly two
lessons.goal: Use the dual ending ־ַיִם, and stop saying two years the long way.

lessons.title: Two nouns, one idea
lessons.goal: Read and build construct chains — Hebrew's compound noun.

lessons.title: Clothes and shopping
lessons.goal: Buy something, and say what you're wearing.

lessons.title: The ending that owns it
lessons.goal: Read בֵּיתוֹ and סְפָרָיו — possession hung on the back of the noun.

lessons.title: The second binyan
lessons.goal: Recognise and use pi'el, the pattern with a doubled middle letter.

lessons.title: The last hundred years
lessons.goal: Screens, wires, engines and the press — the words Hebrew had to invent.

lessons.title: Work and study
lessons.goal: Say what you do and where you do it.

lessons.title: Saying no
lessons.goal: Negate a verb, an existence, and a whole idea.

lessons.title: How much, how many
lessons.goal: Quantify things, and compare them.

lessons.title: Animals
lessons.goal: Name the animals — and read the fables the library is full of.

lessons.title: Weather and the natural world
lessons.goal: Talk about the weather, the seasons and the landscape.

levels.name: The verb system
levels.blurb: The future, the infinitive, and the seven binyanim — the machinery that makes Hebrew guessable.

lessons.title: What will happen
lessons.goal: Use the future of pa'al, where the person is a prefix rather than an ending.

lessons.title: To do something
lessons.goal: Form and use the infinitive.

lessons.title: A day, in verbs
lessons.goal: Say what you did from waking to sleeping.

lessons.title: You have to, you can, you mustn't
lessons.goal: Build the sentences that have no subject and no conjugated verb.

lessons.title: Making it happen
lessons.goal: Recognise hif'il and its causative sense.

lessons.title: Having it happen to you
lessons.goal: Recognise nif'al, the passive counterpart of pa'al.

lessons.title: Doing it to yourself
lessons.goal: Recognise hitpa'el — and the letter-swap that hides it.

lessons.title: Speech and thought
lessons.goal: The verbs that introduce everything else in a sentence.

lessons.title: The future everywhere else
lessons.goal: Read the future of pi'el, hif'il and hitpa'el — same four prefixes, different stem.

lessons.title: The two passives
lessons.goal: Recognise pu'al and huf'al on the page.

lessons.title: Written, closed, known
lessons.goal: Read the פָּעוּל form — the state an action leaves a thing in.

lessons.title: Telling someone to do it
lessons.goal: Give an order — the textbook way and the way people actually speak.

lessons.title: Roots that misbehave
lessons.goal: Read verbs whose roots contain נ, ו or ה and don't follow the tables.

lessons.title: The preposition the verb wants
lessons.goal: Learn verbs together with the preposition they take — because it is rarely English's.

lessons.title: Three more families that misbehave
lessons.goal: Read roots that begin with י, end with א, or end with a guttural.

levels.name: Structure and style
levels.blurb: Joining clauses, conditionals, verbal nouns, and the distance between spoken and written Hebrew.

lessons.title: Joining clauses
lessons.goal: Use שֶׁ, כִּי and כְּדֵי to build sentences longer than one clause.

lessons.title: The small words that hold an argument together
lessons.goal: Connectives — the vocabulary of essays rather than conversation.

lessons.title: Saying when
lessons.goal: Attach a clause of time — before, after, while, until, ever since.

lessons.title: If
lessons.goal: Tell a real condition from an impossible one.

lessons.title: Feeling and character
lessons.goal: Describe a person, and how they are.

lessons.title: The act itself
lessons.goal: Recognise verbal nouns — the reading, the writing, the development.

lessons.title: Ideas and abstractions
lessons.goal: The nouns essays and novels are actually built from.

lessons.title: How words are built
lessons.goal: Read a word you have never met by recognising the shape it was poured into.

lessons.title: How it's done
lessons.goal: Modify a verb — with an adverb, or with a preposition and a noun.

lessons.title: Word order
lessons.goal: Know the default order, and what moving a word does.

lessons.title: The road out
lessons.goal: Journeys, ships, borders and exile — the register modern Hebrew literature lives in.

lessons.title: Society and argument
lessons.goal: The nouns of politics, history and criticism.

lessons.title: Written and spoken
lessons.goal: Read the formal forms that speech has dropped.

lessons.title: Marks on the page
lessons.goal: Read the two marks, the letter-numbers and the abbreviations a real page is full of.

levels.name: Reading literature
levels.blurb: The older forms you'll meet in the library — and how to read a page of it unaided.

lessons.title: The vav that flips the tense
lessons.goal: Read narrative past in biblical style — future forms that mean the past.

lessons.title: Kings, prophets and war
lessons.goal: The vocabulary of the narrative books — and of everything written in their shadow.

lessons.title: Older pronouns and endings
lessons.goal: Recognise the pronouns and suffixes that modern Hebrew has retired.

lessons.title: The literary register
lessons.goal: The words a hundred-year-old page assumes you know.

lessons.title: Directions and other survivals
lessons.goal: Read the ־ָה that means towards, and the other fossils around it.

lessons.title: Rabbinic Hebrew and its Aramaic
lessons.goal: The words and abbreviations that fill a page of commentary.

lessons.title: How poems are built
lessons.goal: Read Hebrew verse — parallelism, compression, inverted order.

lessons.title: The vocabulary of verse
lessons.goal: The words poems reach for, and their plainer twins.

lessons.title: Words that moved
lessons.goal: Know the common words whose old sense is not their modern one.

lessons.title: Reading without vowels
lessons.goal: Read the unpointed spelling every real book is printed in.

lessons.title: Reading a real page
lessons.goal: Put it together on unedited literary Hebrew.
